method: Full case consideration for each exact pinned discovery version; not-established-from-task is not proof of no-match under later consuming implementation, and positive candidates remain unexecuted and independently unaccepted.

decisions.rationale: Discovery is advisory and does not establish a current delegated authority after an identified revocation event.
Type support is a service capability assertion; no actual delegated actor exercising an out-of-scope grant is specified by discovery alone.
The response does not preserve a dependent delegation whose authority source has subsequently been revoked.
Listing a supported Type URI is not a judgment that a revoked artifact remains currently valid.
The exchange does not declare a previously superseded artifact to be the current authoritative successor.
No historical validity question is answered by treating the present removal of a supported type as erasure of past validity.
The responder does not present multiple supposedly independent corroborating authorities for one trust proposition.
The protocol does not reconcile materially conflicting determinations from two competent authorities.
Discovery does not assert a transitive trust-recognition chain from one registry or party to another.
A filtered supportedTypes response is a scoped subset, not an exhaustive authority or service inventory; no-match across an unrequested namespace is not evidenced.
decisions.test_hypothesis: Query only one slug family, omit an existing supported type in another family, and test that the discoverer does not conclude global absence.
decisions.authority_boundary: Pattern-filtered reply versus universe-wide availability evidence.

decisions.rationale: The responder's advertised acceptance policy is time/context-bounded and may not establish freshness at a later material decision.

The 0.1/0.2 frameworkVersion difference establishes protocol-envelope compatibility, not a material trust decision claiming evaluation under the wrong governance policy. DTF-012's identified policy-version preconditions are not established by discovery alone.
Even correctly authenticated discovery is a service advertisement, not a principal-signed authorization for an unrelated commitment.
decisions.test_hypothesis: Accept a valid signed discovery response, then attempt a material action with no principal authorization; require denial.
decisions.authority_boundary: Responder attribution versus authorized principal commitment.

decisions.rationale: An expiring actor mandate authorizing a new commitment after expiry is not defined by this read-only meta-task.
The discovery operation contains no series of later offers that can exceed an iterative negotiating mandate.
No agent interaction begins under authority and then attempts a new commitment after mid-interaction mandate revocation within discovery.
No independently approved exact action is substituted or stale at a later commitment in this advisory operation.
The source explicitly calls presence of a Type URI advisory and requires the full subsequent acceptance pipeline.
decisions.test_hypothesis: Discover an offered type and submit it from an unauthorized actor; reject using independent runtime policy.
decisions.authority_boundary: Capability advertisement versus permission to execute.

decisions.rationale: The discovery response cannot reconstruct the full mandate, decision-time policy and approval evidence of a past material commitment.
The responder owns its advertised support/acceptance rules while the relying executor owns its later policy; no ambiguous owner of a single decisive fact is established.
Discovery-time support or acceptance metadata may be stale at a later material execution boundary; later authorization remains independently required.
An authenticated supportedTypes exchange never proves the subsequent task was accepted or its effect occurred.
decisions.test_hypothesis: Record successful discovery and then make the actual task fail; require execution result to remain failed or unresolved.
decisions.authority_boundary: Discovery negotiation versus executed effect.

decisions.rationale: Two locally conforming stages, discovery and task execution, still need separate validity, origin and authority checks at the composition seam.
decisions.test_hypothesis: Use a valid discovery response but an unauthorized or expired follow-on task; refuse composed-success PASS.
